title: Fix Libraries follow-up click-path issues
summary: Resolve follow-up Libraries tab click-path audit findings for Add Library activation, backend command busy handling, route-map fetch failures, compare state coloring, and default-reset wording.
reason: The follow-up scan found residual operator-trust risks where control labels, async errors, busy commands, and profile selection could leave the Libraries UI unclear even though backend persistence remained owned by Preview/Save.
behavior_before: Add Library could reopen a stored profile instead of the new one, Library Preview/Save could rebuild local patches while another settings command was busy, route-map detail failures could leave loading rows, compare state colors were weak, and the default-reset button label overstated its scope.
behavior_after: Add Library activates the new profile, Library Preview/Save honor local and shared busy gates, route-map detail failures render explicit error rows/warnings, compare states carry semantic data-state values, and the reset button label matches override-only behavior.
rollback_plan: Revert the Libraries WebView, CSS, tests, generated summaries, and this change packet updates.
notes:
WebView display/staging only. Backend Preview/Save remains authoritative; this change must not launch processing, mutate queue state, publish, rename, drain pending publish, or touch media.
Follow-up Libraries UI fixes: Add Library activation ignores stale stored tab IDs, Preview/Save guard busy settings commands, route-map detail requests render failure evidence, compare states expose semantic data-state coloring, override reset label is explicit.
